why.rationale: This surface IS the Strategy Pattern: a shared context (vestibule lines 47-160) selects between interchangeable execution strategies (parallel vs sequential) at a single dispatch point (line 184). Route-language: a shared vestibule that opens onto two hallways via one decision-desk is the spatial form of strategy-dispatch. But the canonical form requires symmetric door-shapes (both strategies as peer functions, both writing comparable state, one filename schema parameterized by ring) and explicit selection (no silent default into door-A). The current shape leaks: door-A is inlined while door-B is functional, schemas diverge, and the desk routes by omission. The pattern is RIGHT; the realization is asymmetric. Recommendation: live-with for v0.2.0-rc.1; refactor toward peer-callable strategies next cycle.
tools_used: symmetry test (peer-callable check across the two strategies)
ship-vs-tend triage (cosmetic asymmetry vs blocking defect)
